description: Defines the EntityRelation class representing relationships between entities, including properties, constructors, and methods for handling relation data and metadata.

classes.name: EntityRelation
classes.description: Represents a relation between two entities with properties like type, relation group, and additional info.

classes.name: EntityRelation.Key
classes.description: A record implementing EdqsObjectKey, uniquely identifying an EntityRelation by UUIDs and relation type info.

methods.name: getAdditionalInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the additional info as a JsonNode, handling serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: setAdditionalInfo
methods.description: Sets the additional info from a JsonNode, updating internal byte array.

methods.name: stringKey
methods.description: Generates a string key representing the relation.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the relation.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the object type, which is RELATION.
